answer: Cap rewards per arrival cohort. Agents that register in the same hour form one cohort, and each cohort shares a fixed reward slice no matter how many members it has. A sybil farmer who spins up a thousand identities at dawn just splits that slice a thousand ways, while honest agents who wander in at scattered times each keep a fair share. Like a crowd on a single knoll, packing more bodies onto the same spot earns no extra ground.
